phase0_note: Phase 0 is offline: full CALVIN trajectories (100+GB of RGB-D) are NOT downloaded. Each fixture is a RECORDED STATE LOG (start scene -> end scene) over exactly the state variables the deterministic predicates read (block 6D pose, drawer/slider joints, binary lightbulb/led). Ground-truth labels are seeded. The predicate is CALVIN's own get_task_info() terminal-state check, reimplemented deterministically. `end` overrides are applied ON TOP OF the start scene (end = start + delta).

scene_schema.blocks: red|blue|pink -> {pos:[x,y,z] meters, yaw: degrees, surface: table|slider|drawer, in_gripper: bool, stacked_on: null|color}

consent_note: Invariant 7: CALVIN is a simulated tabletop manipulation benchmark. No health-adjacent or personal data is present; default-deny is satisfied vacuously.
